about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the builder and the phase judge ran as their own subagents; the judge wrote PHASE-REVIEW.md itself; the judge touched the held-out suite and the builder did not; the run ended on the outer loop's bar at the stop node. The design bet (write-up): the judge says next-phase after phase 1, fail once at phase 2 on the held-out cases, then pass; both back edges of the outer loop are taken.
